title: Payroll Review and Reconciliation
summary: Automated payroll review and spreadsheet reconciliation workflows with Python and Pandas, plus an OPE approval PDF export system.
overview: A workflow-automation project at JHS & Associates LLP covering payroll review, spreadsheet reconciliation and an OPE approval PDF export system.
problem: Payroll review and reconciling spreadsheets are repetitive, detail-heavy tasks. Automating them reduces manual handling.
approach: Automated payroll review and spreadsheet reconciliation workflows using Python and Pandas.
Built an OPE approval PDF export system as part of the workflow.

architecture.label: Data processing
architecture.detail: Python and Pandas process spreadsheet data.

architecture.label: Approval output
architecture.detail: An OPE approval PDF export system produces approval documents.

architecture.label: Rules, input formats, validation checks and what OPE stands for
architecture.detail: Not specified in the source material.

workflow.step: Payroll spreadsheets are read and reviewed with Python and Pandas.

items: Automated payroll review and spreadsheet reconciliation workflows and the OPE approval PDF export system.

limitations: No employee payroll data is published. Only the documented workflow is described.
